scope: Curated migration reading map, not a complete call graph, dependency closure or semantic-completion score. Contract paths mean source exists, not execution passed.

invariants: Runtime initializes objects before mounting a, b, c DAT in that order.
Executable-relative assets; do not add a working-directory/reference-directory fallback.
blockers: WinMain, Win32 workers, COM and legacy global ownership remain coupled.

invariants: Runtime hashing includes NUL and retains Windows case rules and the singleton CRC shortcut.
Virtual stream and guarded exact-read/relative-skip contracts remain different.
Tool DatArchive normalization and raw payload reads are not runtime reader semantics.
Index decoder uses the caller-owned shared MT19937; cursor parsing does not change incremental mount publication.
blockers: HANDLE, thiscall, 12/28-byte host layout, locale-sensitive hash/compare, partial mount failure policy.

invariants: Packed lookup replaces the last four bytes, not only an actual .nut suffix.
Standalone bytecode and text retain different VM slots, stack/error and environment rules.
ACT embedded script execution is a separate path.
blockers: SQInteger-sized legacy CV4 serialization versus host pointer/hash width; old bindings and integer slots.

invariants: Document owns a reader only during load; consumers borrow it.
Stage and map load have different return-value/cleanup behavior; do not unify by symmetry.
Unknown padding is not zero-initialized speculatively.
blockers: Loading failure and ownership recovery completed in act-ownership-20260926; remaining internal field/type cleanup is distinct from runtime validation and future x64 layout work.

invariants: Publish packed handle before construction; generation update and free-slot LIFO stay ordered.
Retirement and pool destruction use different actor delete flags.
blockers: Creation/binding, frame update/destruction and scene restart recovery completed in object-scene-chain-20260926; exceptional runtime scenarios remain unverified.

invariants: Input/callback/mask snapshot/update order must survive backend changes.
Preserve positive-infinity rounding and existing arithmetic order; do not assume a new 60 Hz delta-time model.
blockers: Timer/thread/device timing and x87/SSE/ARM floating-point equivalence lack cross-platform acceptance evidence.

invariants: Submission order, alpha/blend, sampling, target reset and borrow lifetime are observable.
blockers: D3D9/D3DX/COM and pixel-center convention; present latency and device-loss behavior.

invariants: Device output is separate from decoding, loop points, gain, queues and borrowed compressed bytes.
blockers: DirectSound and worker synchronization; do not upgrade codec, mixer and device backend in one step.

invariants: Container tags, null terminators, one-byte bool and four-byte integer/float remain format fields, not host layouts.
blockers: Savedata file round-trip and independent wire fixtures added in boundary-closeout-20260926; execution remains pending. Mod-profile migration is a future goal, not a Win32 implementation blocker.

invariants: Source, original evidence, vendor provenance and test execution provenance travel together.
A lexical candidate percentage or a compiled contract is not semantic acceptance.
blockers: Schema-2 census makes file-wide markers visible but is not AST/semantic acceptance; vendor licensing and platform behavior need explicit review.
